According to the sunrise and sunset times (Beijing time) for two consecutive days in four regions of the world on that day shown in the table below, infer what day, hour, and minute the local time of place 1 was when Chang'e-3 was launched?

<image1>

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a sunrise/sunset table and focus on row ①. Compute the midpoint of row ① on the given day: (9:00 + 23:00) / 2 = 16:00 Beijing time, so when Beijing time is 16:00, location 1 local time is 12:00. Thus location 1 local time is 4 hours behind Beijing time. The text says the launch is Beijing time 2013-12-02 01:30. Subtract 4 hours to get location 1 local time: 2013-12-01 21:30.
